summary.one_liner: CrewAI is an open-source Python framework for building multi-agent workflows, combining role-based agent Crews with event-driven Flows.
summary.what_it_does: CrewAI lets developers define teams of role-based AI agents (Crews) that collaborate on tasks through delegation and shared context. It also provides Flows, event-driven workflows with decorators like @start, @listen and @router, typed state, and conditional branching, which can invoke Crews as steps. The CLI scaffolds a project with JSONC agent and crew definitions, and runs them with sequential or hierarchical processes. The README also mentions tools, memory, knowledge files, checkpointing, async execution, human input, structured outputs, and MCP/A2A support. Models are configured through LLM connections, with OpenAI as the default and local models such as Ollama mentioned as options. A commercial CrewAI AMP Suite with a Crew Control Plane (tracing and observability) is described separately.
use_cases: orchestrate teams of LLM agents with roles and tasks
event-driven automation with conditional branching in Python
trip planning and stock analysis examples
how_to_run: Set your model provider API key (and SERPER_API_KEY if using web search) in the .env file
notable: Two complementary paradigms: autonomous Crews and precise event-driven Flows that can be combined
Project scaffold uses agents/*.jsonc and crew.jsonc with {placeholder} inputs prompted by the CLI
Flows support or_ and and_ operators for complex triggers
Anonymous telemetry that can be disabled with OTEL_SDK_DISABLED
caveats: Some features (tracing, unified control plane, on-premise deployment, 24/7 support) belong to the commercial CrewAI AMP Suite; the Crew Control Plane is only described as free to try
Sending telemetry is on by default; the share_crew option sends detailed task data if enabled
